stage1.impression: A warm, timber-lined bar seen along a long counter at night, with two big horn speakers in niches, a wall of records and low dome pendants. It has the right ingredients, but it reads as a competent CG render. The empty, evenly lit cubbies are the brightest thing in the frame. The speakers sit behind a glossy black sheet whose sky-white reflection hides them. The pendants are flat white discs, and the stools are cream plastic-looking shapes that overlap one another. As it stands a magazine would see a generic, catalogue bar, not a specific place: the record wall and the speaker niches are the specific idea, but neither is legible.

blocking_9: Each speaker reads at a glance as tinted cast acrylic with its white batts and horn visible, not hidden behind a mirror-like reflection; the white sky-coloured reflection patch in the left niche (around 250,120 to 330,180, median 223) is gone
The empty oak cubbies (360,80 to 620,450, median 115) sit below the speakers in luminance and are filled with records, so the record wall reads as full and lived-in
The Dome pendants show smoked acrylic with a warm glowing liner, not white opal discs at about 218 neutral
Stools and counter chairs do not overlap or intersect, and their seats read as leather or upholstery, not cream plastic
The back of the room (850,0 to 1200,460) has a pool of light and a readable surface (concrete, beam or record wall) rather than a flat, muddy dark wall
The grain and noise at 1:1 is reduced to a fine photographic grain; no blotchy denoiser texture on the dark wood and walls

defects.what: Large glossy black reflection over the left speaker niche, with a bright, sky-white trapezoid reflection (median 223, neutral) that reads as a TV screen or display glass and hides the horn
The speaker cabinet reads as a grey, slightly skewed box with a white woofer; no tint and no acrylic depth; it reads as a speaker in a display case
The right speaker is the same, with a near-clipping white reflection (clip 0.12 %) and a grey cabinet
The cubbies are mostly empty and evenly lit from behind (median 115, brighter than the speaker at 54); a showroom shelf, not a used record wall
The Dome pendant reads as a flat white opal half-sphere; no smoked tint visible; the same model repeated four times at identical brightness
The far pendants are near-white (median 218) and float in a featureless dark
The back of the room is a flat, muddy brown-grey wall with no materials, no light pool and visible blotchy noise
The stools and chair backs overlap and nearly intersect; the cream seats read as plastic; the chair back at 980,550 to 1110,800 is a flat, untextured slab
The foreground chair back is crushed to near black (median 5, crush 44 %) with a hard, CG rim
The record player lids and glasses read as thin, grey, flat-shaded sheets; the coupe glass edges are aliased
The zinc counter top reads as pale smooth concrete with a uniform sheen; no zinc patina or wear
Overall coarse, blotchy noise and grain at 1:1, typical of denoised CPU path tracing

changes.problem: The speakers, the hero, are hidden behind a glossy reflection and are darker than the empty shelves beside them, so the eye goes to the cubbies.

evidence.measured: speaker median 53.6 vs cubbies (360,80,620,450) median 114.7; reflection patch (250,120,330,180) median 222.7, neutral RGB 220/223/223

change.setting: on each Ember speaker 4 x area (W/m2 at the target) and the lit niche's strip
change.to: 3.0 W/m2 at 2900 K, niche strip 0.6, and the niche's grazing light aimed from above and inside the niche so it lights the acrylic and batts, not the front glass

changes.expected: The cabinets glow from within, smoke tint and white batts legible; the speakers become the brightest non-lamp objects on the back bar.

changes.problem: The record wall is backlit evenly and is brighter than the speakers, and empty bays show as bright boxes.

change.to: 2.5 W, 2400 K, cone 18 deg, aimed as grazing pools from the top of the shelf down the spines, leaving gaps between pools

changes.expected: The record wall falls into warm pools with dark between them, below the speakers in brightness.

changes.problem: The cubbies are mostly empty, which reads as a showroom shelf, not a working listening bar's record wall.

evidence.measured: visible as bare oak boxes; only two bays (560,370 to 610,445 and 10,340 to 85,450) hold records

change.setting: props: records on the record wall
change.to: every bay at least 70 % filled with spines of mixed height and wear, a few records leaning, two sleeves face-out, one bay left half empty

changes.expected: The wall reads as a used collection; small specular highlights on the spines.

changes.problem: The Dome pendants read as white opal discs; their liners are near clipping and hide the smoked tint.

change.setting: each Dome's liner glow and lamp
change.to: 12 W, glow 0.02, so the smoked shell reads dark over a warm liner and the light goes down onto the zinc

changes.expected: The pendants read as smoked domes with a warm amber glow below; the white disc look is gone.

changes.problem: The back of the room is a featureless muddy dark with no pool of light or legible material, so the depth reads as a void.

change.to: 90 W, 2500 K, cone 22 deg, with a third spot added at 25 W raking the back wall's board-formed concrete

changes.expected: A pool on the back concrete shows its formwork grain; the room has a lit destination at its far end.

changes.problem: The stool and chair seats read as cream plastic, and the counter top as smooth concrete rather than zinc.

change.setting: materials' finish: the zinc's patina and the seats' finish
change.to: zinc darker with a mottled, oxidised grey-blue patina and ring marks; the seats a darker tan leather with roughness 0.55 and a subtle crease normal map

changes.expected: The seats sit back into the room; the counter reads as worn zinc catching pools of the Dome light.

changes.problem: The foreground chair back blocks the lower-left third as crushed black, and the stools on the right overlap into a confused cluster.

change.to: [3.6, 2.7, 1.25] at [7.6, 5.7, 1.45], 35 mm, so the foreground chair falls out of frame on the left and the stools separate

changes.expected: The counter's fluted front and the speakers fill the lower left; the stools on the right read as a row, not overlapping.

changes.problem: The coarse grain and blotchy denoised noise at 1:1 give away the render, especially on dark wood and the back wall.

evidence.measured: visible mottled noise in the crop; p5 13.6 with no structure

change.to: samples 1024, adaptive 0.008, with a light film grain added in post at about 1.5 % rather than letting the render noise stand in for it

changes.expected: Clean shadows with a fine, even grain; no blotches on the dark surfaces.

out_of_scope.request: Show the speakers' tint more strongly; in Smoke they read as grey boxes, so the frame has no single saturated hero colour (the red votives are the most saturated things in it)
out_of_scope.why: The speakers' colour and the configuration are fixed; only their lighting can change (c1)

out_of_scope.request: Remove or rework the glass front over the niches that mirrors the room
out_of_scope.why: The niches are part of the room's design as fixed; if that sheet is not meant to be there, the model should be checked

out_of_scope.request: Vary the four identical Dome pendants
out_of_scope.why: EARF's lamp is a fixed product
